name: influencer.tag_add
description: Adds a tag to a person, after the team's others: a short topic in lower case (a leading # and extra spaces are dropped). Every member of the person's company may. The model's job never takes it away, and a tag the team removed before may be added again. Answers the person's tags.
sql:
update brandbase.influencers i set
  tags_team = case when t.v = any (i.tags_team) then i.tags_team else i.tags_team || t.v end,
  tags_ai = array_remove(i.tags_ai, t.v),
  tags_hidden = array_remove(i.tags_hidden, t.v)
from (select brandbase.tag_of(:tag::text) as v) t
where i.id = :id::uuid and (cardinality(i.tags_team) < 20 or t.v = any (i.tags_team))
returning jsonb_build_object('id', i.id, 'tags', brandbase.influencer_tags(i.tags_team, i.tags_ai)) as result

empty.message: a creator has at most 20 tags of the team's own
